text:
EvalBot: nightly-evals: prompt_suite_v2 — semantics_f1 fell from 0.88 -> 0.72 for rwd-open-v2-quant (canary). Alerting because delta > 0.10. dashboard: https://dash.internal/reports/pset_v2
Maya: did the rebaseline land yesterday?
Sam: yeah, landed ~10:05pm UTC (PR #4821). small wording edits to 3 prompts + one gold label update.
Jun: pulling example failures now, here's one very representative:
```
PROMPT: Explain why the sky looks blue to a child.
GOLD: Light scatters more at short wavelengths, blue appears stronger.
MODEL_OUT (quant): "Because the ocean is blue, so the sky copies it."
```
Maya: whoa — that's a semantic hallucination, not just phrasing.
Olivia: is the regression only on the quantized variant? what about rwd-open-v2 (fp16)?
Sam: fp16 steady: semantics_f1 0.87 -> 0.86 (noise). quant is the clear outlier.
Jun: I diffed the prompt changes: original had "When asked to explain, emphasize scattering of light" -> new wording removed the explicit scattering hint.
Maya: so prompt got slightly more open-ended. That could interact badly with quantized temperature + generation-policy.
Olivia: can we reproduce locally with quant flags? i.e. run `make eval PROMPT_SET=prompt_suite_v2 MODEL=rwd-open-v2-quant --sample-seed=42`
Sam: running now, but note nightly used `max_tokens=120, temp=0.0, top_p=0.95` for these tests.
Jun: quick experiment: revert the 1-line prompt change and re-run, small patch reduces hallucinations in our sample set.
Maya: options: 1) revert prompt wording (fast), 2) rebaseline golds to accept new style (requires approval + audit), 3) tweak quant inference flags (safe but might change perf).
Olivia: my vote is revert for canary until we understand exact interaction. Then create a follow-up to either rebaseline with expanded evals or tune quant kernels.
Sam: opened PR to revert the wording (https://git.internal/psets/PR-4830) and kicked off CI eval.
Jun: added a small unit test that checks the presence of scattering-related concepts in answers for these prompts. CI will fail if not present.
Maya: +1 on revert for canary. After CI passes, roll out revert to nightly and re-run whole pset.
Olivia: filing a short postmortem card and tagging quant-ops to investigate kernel sensitivity: https://tasks.internal/RED-221
Sam: action items: Sam -> monitor CI & canary rollback. Jun -> extend unit tests for 12 representative prompts. Olivia -> coordinate rebaseline meeting if revert doesn't fix. Maya -> sign off on revert.
Maya: thanks all. please ping #eng-oncall if canary behaves oddly after rollback. :thumbsup:
